usermeta.idiom: Map: binned density grid over marine park outlines (required map #2)
todo: Run scripts/fetch_ala.py to create data/ala_occurrences.csv (README, step 2).
The 'species_sel' parameter is driven by the global dropdown in index.html; the default below must be one of the names in js/main.js SPECIES.
Pick a cell size: step 0.5 degrees is a reasonable start. Smaller = finer but noisier.
Colour scale is sqrt so single sightings stay visible; switch to log if one hotspot swamps everything.
Overlay is the story: how much of this species' range sits inside a park? Write that into the caption once you can see it.
Same projection as chart 1; keep them identical so readers can flip between the two.
